title: The Boy's Own Paper
additional-notes: This is a British publication. Its contents may still be copyrighted even without renewals or copyright notices, if they meet GATT copyright restoration requirements for works first published outside the US.

Much of the content of this weekly paper was reprinted in the Boy's Own Annual.  Many of the Annual volumes are now available online, and they are easier to find in many libraries than the original Boy's Own Paper issues.
